intro: Aucklanders have a wide range of gym options, with prices starting from $15 per week. However, navigating the numerous suburbs and franchises can be overwhelming. This guide will help you find the best gym for your needs and budget.

sections.heading: Gym Options by Suburb
sections.body: Auckland's suburbs offer a diverse range of gyms, from budget-friendly options to high-end facilities. Some popular suburbs for gyms include the CBD, Ponsonby, and Newmarket.

sections.heading: Price Comparison
sections.body: When choosing a gym, it's essential to consider the price and contract terms. The following table compares the prices of popular gyms in Auckland.

sections.heading: Parking and Accessibility
sections.body: For those who prefer to drive to the gym, parking can be a significant consideration. Many gyms in Auckland offer on-site parking, while others are located near public transport hubs.
